Meet Ruchi

R

Ruchi founded Ruchi's Phonics Land to help children build a genuine love of reading — through play, activities, games and fun worksheets. She holds a B.E. and a Diploma in Early Childhood Care & Education, and has spent years teaching phonics online — working one-on-one and in small groups with students across India and abroad. She's comfortable teaching with both British and American English conventions, adapting to whichever fits each family best.

Every family gets a personal connection — Ruchi checks in directly with parents and adapts her teaching to how each child learns best.

English Hindi Gujarati Ages 4–13

Programmes

For ages 4 to 13, taught online one-on-one or in small groups of 5–8 by age — with recitation, storytelling, debates, and presentations woven in along the way to build confidence as much as vocabulary.

Phonics Foundations

Letter sounds, blending, and phonemic awareness for early readers.

Reading & Writing

Sight words, sentence building, and creative writing practice.

Grammar & Composition

Structured grammar concepts are taught from the basics to advanced levels through activities, quizzes, and games.

English Language Support

Building communication skills, vocabulary, and enhancing creativity alongside school curriculum.

Sound It Out: A Parent's Guide to Phonics

A phonics workshop for parents, so you can understand and reinforce the method at home — in addition to your child's regular classes.

Grammar Refresher

Quick refresher sessions on grammar concepts for ages 7–13 — a top-up alongside regular classes, not a full course. Ask about upcoming sessions.

What to Expect

A look at what a typical session actually involves — starting with a free trial class to see if it's a good fit.

1

Warm-up & sound review

A few minutes revisiting sounds and words from the last session, so nothing's forgotten between classes.

2

Guided reading & writing

Focused, one-on-one or small-group practice at the child's actual level — not a fixed script everyone follows the same way.

3

An activity or game

Play is how the ideas actually stick — a short game, story, or activity built around whatever was just practiced.

4

Wrap-up & take-home practice

A quick recap, and something small to reinforce at home before the next session.

5

Individual feedback

Even in a group setting, feedback on your child's progress is given individually — not lumped into a single class-wide update.

Common Questions

What most parents ask before getting started.

What age should my child start?

Ruchi's Phonics Land takes children from age 4 through 13. Younger children usually start with sound and letter foundations; older children join for reading, writing, grammar, or ongoing English support alongside school.

Are classes online or in person?

All classes are conducted online over Zoom, so families anywhere can join — including students outside India.

One-on-one or group classes?

Both formats are available. Many families start one-on-one and move into a small group (5–8 children, matched by age) once a child is comfortable — whatever fits your child best.

How long is a class?

Generally 60–75 minutes, kept flexible based on what a batch actually needs.

Can we try a class first?

Yes — a free trial class is always available. It's the easiest way to see if it's a good fit before committing to anything.

How much does it cost?

This varies by programme and format. Message on WhatsApp or email below and Ruchi will share current fees.

Will I know how my child is progressing?

Yes — Ruchi checks in directly with parents rather than leaving updates to a single term-end report, so you're not left guessing between sessions.
